main.description: Points an open pull at another target branch, another head branch, or both, as `knotless pull retarget` does, as the account logged in to this appview's web pages. Anyone who may close it changes its target branch; only its author its head branch, which must be in the repository it comes from. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets.

errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.
errors.name: AuthenticationRequired

errors.description: It was not retargeted, as the reason says: no such branch, or the account may not.
errors.name: UpstreamFailure

base.description: The branch of the repository to merge it into, without refs/heads/.

head.description: The branch of the repository it comes from to bring in, without refs/heads/.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

description: Points a pull at other branches as the account logged in to this appview's pages.
